description.en: Implement a queue using an array. Support enqueue (add to rear), dequeue (remove from front), and display operations. Process Q queries.
description.hi: Array use karke queue implement karo. Enqueue (rear mein add), dequeue (front se remove), aur display operations support karo. Q queries process karo.

explanation.en: After enqueue 10,20,30 and dequeue (removes 10), remaining queue is 20 30
explanation.hi: Enqueue 10,20,30 ke baad dequeue (10 remove), bachi queue 20 30

hints.en: Use front and rear pointers to track the queue boundaries
hints.hi: Front aur rear pointers se queue ki boundaries track karo

hints.en: Handle underflow when dequeue is called on empty queue
hints.hi: Empty queue pe dequeue call hone par underflow handle karo

starterCode.python:
q = int(input())
queue = []
# Process queries: enqueue x, dequeue, display

approach.en: Use an array with front and rear pointers. Enqueue increments rear and adds element. Dequeue increments front. Display prints from front to rear.
approach.hi: Array mein front aur rear pointers use karo. Enqueue rear increment karke element add karta hai. Dequeue front increment karta hai. Display front se rear tak print karta hai.

solution.timeComplexity: O(1) for enqueue, O(1) for dequeue (array), O(n) for display

description.en: Implement a queue using two stacks. Support enqueue and dequeue operations. The queue must follow FIFO order.
description.hi: Do stacks use karke queue implement karo. Enqueue aur dequeue operations support karo. Queue ko FIFO order follow karna chahiye.

examples.input:
7
enqueue 1
enqueue 2
dequeue
enqueue 3
dequeue
dequeue
dequeue

explanation.en: Dequeues return 1, 2, 3 in FIFO order. Last dequeue on empty queue gives Underflow.
explanation.hi: Dequeue FIFO order mein 1, 2, 3 return karta hai. Empty queue pe last dequeue Underflow deta hai.

hints.en: Use stack1 for enqueue and stack2 for dequeue
hints.hi: Stack1 enqueue ke liye aur stack2 dequeue ke liye use karo

hints.en: Transfer elements from stack1 to stack2 only when stack2 is empty
hints.hi: Stack1 se stack2 mein elements tabhi transfer karo jab stack2 empty ho

starterCode.python:
q = int(input())
s1, s2 = [], []
# Process enqueue x, dequeue

testCases.input:
7
enqueue 1
enqueue 2
dequeue
enqueue 3
dequeue
dequeue
dequeue

approach.en: Use two stacks: s1 for enqueue (push), s2 for dequeue (pop). When dequeue is called and s2 is empty, transfer all elements from s1 to s2. This reverses the order giving FIFO behavior.
approach.hi: Do stacks use karo: s1 enqueue ke liye (push), s2 dequeue ke liye (pop). Jab dequeue call ho aur s2 empty ho, toh s1 ke saare elements s2 mein transfer karo. Ye order reverse karta hai jo FIFO behavior deta hai.

problems.title: Generate Binary Numbers from 1 to N
problems.titleHi: 1 se N tak Binary Numbers Generate Karo

description.en: Given a number N, generate and print all binary numbers from 1 to N using a queue.
description.hi: Ek number N diya hai, queue use karke 1 se N tak saare binary numbers generate aur print karo.

hints.en: Start with '1' in queue. For each number, enqueue it+'0' and it+'1'
hints.hi: Queue mein '1' se start karo. Har number ke liye usmein '0' aur '1' jod ke enqueue karo

hints.en: Dequeue N times to get the first N binary numbers
hints.hi: N baar dequeue karo toh pehle N binary numbers mil jayenge

starterCode.python:
from collections import deque
n = int(input())
# Generate binary numbers 1 to n
starterCode.javascript:
const n = parseInt(require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8').trim());
// Generate binary numbers 1 to n

approach.en: Start by enqueuing '1'. For each dequeue, print the string, then enqueue string+'0' and string+'1'. Repeat N times.
approach.hi: '1' enqueue karke start karo. Har dequeue pe string print karo, phir string+'0' aur string+'1' enqueue karo. N baar repeat karo.

code.python:
q = deque(['1'])
result = []
for i in range(n):
    s = q.popleft()
    result.append(s)
    q.append(s + '0')
    q.append(s + '1')
print(' '.join(result))

problems.title: First Non-Repeating Character in a Stream

description.en: Given a stream of characters, find the first non-repeating character at each point in the stream. If no non-repeating character exists, print -1.
description.hi: Characters ka stream diya hai, stream ke har point pe pehla non-repeating character dhundho. Agar koi non-repeating character nahi hai toh -1 print karo.

explanation.en: After 'a': first non-rep='a'. After 'aa': none=-1. After 'aab': 'b'. After 'aabc': 'b'. After 'aabcb': 'c'. After 'aabcbc': none=-1.
explanation.hi: After 'a': pehla non-rep='a'. After 'aa': koi nahi=-1. After 'aab': 'b'. After 'aabc': 'b'. After 'aabcb': 'c'. After 'aabcbc': koi nahi=-1.

hints.en: Use a queue to maintain order and a frequency map to track counts
hints.hi: Order maintain karne ke liye queue aur counts track karne ke liye frequency map use karo

hints.en: Pop from front of queue while front character has frequency > 1
hints.hi: Queue ke front se pop karte raho jab tak front character ki frequency > 1 ho

starterCode.python:
from collections import deque
s = input()
# Find first non-repeating at each step
starterCode.javascript:
const s = require('fs').readFileSync('/dev/stdin','utf8').trim();
// Find first non-repeating at each step

approach.en: Use a queue and frequency map. For each character: increment freq, push to queue. Then pop from front while freq[front] > 1. If queue not empty, front is the answer, else -1.
approach.hi: Queue aur frequency map use karo. Har character ke liye: freq increment karo, queue mein push karo. Phir front se pop karte raho jab tak freq[front] > 1. Agar queue empty nahi, front answer hai, warna -1.

hints.hi: Full condition: (rear + 1) % k == front

description.en: Given an array of integers and a window size k, find the maximum element in each sliding window of size k as it moves from left to right.
description.hi: Integers ka array aur window size k diya hai. Jaise window left se right move karti hai, har window of size k mein maximum element dhundho.

hints.en: Use a deque to store indices of useful elements in current window
hints.hi: Current window mein useful elements ke indices store karne ke liye deque use karo

hints.en: Remove elements from back of deque that are smaller than current element
hints.hi: Deque ke peeche se wo elements hatao jo current element se chhote hain

hints.en: Remove front element if it's outside the current window
hints.hi: Front element hatao agar wo current window ke bahar ho

starterCode.python:
from collections import deque
n, k = map(int, input().split())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Find max in each sliding window of size k

approach.en: Use a deque to store indices in decreasing order of values. For each element: remove indices outside window from front, remove smaller elements from back, push current index. Front of deque is the max for current window.
approach.hi: Deque mein indices ko values ke decreasing order mein store karo. Har element ke liye: window ke bahar ke indices front se hatao, chhote elements back se hatao, current index push karo. Deque ka front current window ka max hai.

description.en: Given an m x n grid where 0=empty, 1=fresh orange, 2=rotten orange. Every minute, fresh oranges adjacent (4-directional) to rotten ones become rotten. Return the minimum minutes until no fresh orange remains, or -1 if impossible.
description.hi: m x n grid diya hai jisme 0=empty, 1=fresh orange, 2=rotten orange. Har minute mein, rotten oranges ke adjacent (4-direction) fresh oranges bhi rotten ho jaate hain. Minimum minutes return karo jab tak koi fresh orange na bache, ya -1 agar impossible ho.

explanation.en: It takes 4 minutes for all oranges to rot spreading from top-left corner.
explanation.hi: Top-left corner se spread hote hue saare oranges ko rot hone mein 4 minutes lagte hain.

hints.en: Use BFS starting from all rotten oranges simultaneously (multi-source BFS)
hints.hi: Saare rotten oranges se ek saath BFS start karo (multi-source BFS)

hints.en: Track time as BFS levels. After BFS, check if any fresh orange remains.
hints.hi: BFS levels ko time ki tarah track karo. BFS ke baad check karo koi fresh orange bacha toh nahi.

starterCode.python:
from collections import deque
m, n = map(int, input().split())
grid = []
for _ in range(m):
    grid.append(list(map(int, input().split())))
# Find min time

approach.en: Multi-source BFS: Add all rotten oranges to queue. BFS level by level, rotting adjacent fresh oranges. Track time as levels. After BFS, if any fresh orange remains, return -1.
approach.hi: Multi-source BFS: Saare rotten oranges queue mein dalo. Level by level BFS karo, adjacent fresh oranges ko rot karo. Levels ko time track karo. BFS ke baad, agar koi fresh orange bacha, -1 return karo.

problems.title: Interleave First Half with Second Half of Queue
problems.titleHi: Queue ki Pehli Aadhi aur Doosri Aadhi ko Interleave Karo

description.en: Given a queue of even length, interleave the first half with the second half. For example, if the queue is [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8], the result should be [1,5,2,6,3,7,4,8].
description.hi: Even length ki queue di hai, pehli half ko second half ke saath interleave karo. For example, agar queue [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8] hai, toh result [1,5,2,6,3,7,4,8] hona chahiye.

hints.en: Dequeue first half into a temporary queue or stack
hints.hi: Pehli half ko temporary queue ya stack mein dequeue karo

hints.en: Alternately dequeue from temp and original queue
hints.hi: Temp aur original queue se alternate karke dequeue karo

starterCode.python:
from collections import deque
n = int(input())
q = deque(map(int, input().split()))
# Interleave first and second halves

approach.en: Dequeue the first half into a temporary queue. Then alternately enqueue from temp and from original queue into the result.
approach.hi: Pehli half ko temporary queue mein dequeue karo. Phir temp aur original queue se alternate karke result mein enqueue karo.

code.python:
half = n // 2
temp = deque()
for _ in range(half):
    temp.append(q.popleft())
result = []
while temp:
    result.append(str(temp.popleft()))
    result.append(str(q.popleft()))
print(' '.join(result))

description.en: Design a Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache with fixed capacity. Support get(key) and put(key, value) operations in O(1) time. When the cache is full and a new key is inserted, remove the least recently used item.
description.hi: Fixed capacity ka Least Recently Used (LRU) Cache design karo. get(key) aur put(key, value) operations O(1) time mein support karo. Jab cache full ho aur naya key insert karna ho, toh sabse purana (least recently used) item hatao.

examples.input:
2
7
put 1 10
put 2 20
get 1
put 3 30
get 2
put 4 40
get 1

explanation.en: Capacity=2. put(1,10), put(2,20). get(1)=10 (1 becomes most recent). put(3,30) evicts key 2 (LRU). get(2)=-1. put(4,40) evicts key 1. get(1)=-1.
explanation.hi: Capacity=2. put(1,10), put(2,20). get(1)=10 (1 most recent ban gaya). put(3,30) key 2 ko evict karta hai (LRU). get(2)=-1. put(4,40) key 1 ko evict karta hai. get(1)=-1.

hints.en: Use a doubly linked list for order and a hash map for O(1) access
hints.hi: Order ke liye doubly linked list aur O(1) access ke liye hash map use karo

hints.en: Most recently used at head, least recently used at tail
hints.hi: Most recently used head pe, least recently used tail pe

hints.en: On get/put, move the node to head (most recent)
hints.hi: Get/put pe node ko head (most recent) pe move karo

starterCode.python:
from collections import OrderedDict
capacity = int(input())
q = int(input())
# Implement LRU Cache

put 2 20
get 1
put 3 30
get 2

get 1

put 2 2
put 3 3

approach.en: Use a doubly linked list (DLL) + hash map. DLL maintains usage order (head=most recent, tail=LRU). Map stores key->node for O(1) lookup. On get: move to head. On put: add to head, if over capacity evict tail.
approach.hi: Doubly linked list (DLL) + hash map use karo. DLL usage order maintain karta hai (head=most recent, tail=LRU). Map key->node store karta hai O(1) lookup ke liye. Get pe: head pe move karo. Put pe: head pe add karo, agar capacity se zyada ho toh tail evict karo.

description.en: Given an array of tasks represented by characters and a cooldown period n, find the minimum number of intervals needed to execute all tasks. The same task must have at least n intervals between two executions. During cooldown, the CPU can execute a different task or remain idle.
description.hi: Tasks ka array (characters se represent) aur cooldown period n diya hai. Saare tasks execute karne ke liye minimum intervals dhundho. Same task ke do executions ke beech kam se kam n intervals hone chahiye. Cooldown mein CPU doosra task execute kar sakta hai ya idle reh sakta hai.

examples.input:
6 2
A A A B B B

explanation.en: One possible order: A B idle A B idle A B. Total 8 intervals.
explanation.hi: Ek possible order: A B idle A B idle A B. Total 8 intervals.

hints.en: The task with maximum frequency determines the minimum intervals
hints.hi: Maximum frequency wala task minimum intervals decide karta hai

hints.en: Formula: (maxFreq - 1) * (n + 1) + count of tasks with maxFreq
hints.hi: Formula: (maxFreq - 1) * (n + 1) + maxFreq wale tasks ka count

hints.en: Answer is max of the formula result and total number of tasks
hints.hi: Answer formula result aur total tasks mein jo bada ho wo hai

starterCode.python:
t, n = map(int, input().split())
tasks = input().split()
# Find minimum intervals

testCases.input:
6 2
A A A B B B

6 0
A A A B B B

12 2
A A A A A A B C D E F G

approach.en: Count frequency of each task. Find max frequency (maxFreq) and how many tasks have that frequency (maxCount). Result = max(total_tasks, (maxFreq - 1) * (n + 1) + maxCount). The formula creates slots of size (n+1) for (maxFreq-1) groups, plus the last group of maxCount tasks.
approach.hi: Har task ki frequency count karo. Max frequency (maxFreq) aur kitne tasks ki wo frequency hai (maxCount) dhundho. Result = max(total_tasks, (maxFreq - 1) * (n + 1) + maxCount). Formula (n+1) size ke slots banata hai (maxFreq-1) groups ke liye, plus last group mein maxCount tasks.

code.python:
from collections import Counter
freq = Counter(tasks)
max_freq = max(freq.values())
max_count = sum(1 for v in freq.values() if v == max_freq)
result = max(t, (max_freq - 1) * (n + 1) + max_count)
print(result)
